May 26, 2018 - By Peter Erickson
Sterling Capital Management Llc increased its stake in Procter & Gamble Co Com (PG) by 15.88% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Sterling Capital Management Llc bought 24,714 shares as the company’s stock declined 15.56% with the market. The institutional investor held 180,295 shares of the package goods and cosmetics company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $16.57 million, up from 155,581 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Sterling Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Procter & Gamble Co Com for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $186.86 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.73% or $0.54 during the last trading session, reaching $74.31. About 7.55M shares traded. The Procter & Gamble Company (NYSE:PG) has declined 14.03% since May 26, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 25.58% the S&P500.
